clips.title: The story
paras: In Twilight Vale, beasts and furbolgs prowl the dark woods between Darkshore and Ashenvale. The southern forest is a perilous threshold between Darkshore’s tainted coast and Ashenvale’s sacred canopies.

Twilight Vale stretches from south of Ameth'Aran to the Ashenvale border, where dusk holds over Darkshore’s southern woods. Corruption has reached deep into the wildlife. Rabid bears roam beside feral nightsabers, while hostile furbolg tribes stalk the trees. Sentinels and travelers advise you to keep to the main road. Even a few paces into the woods can bring a swift, deadly ambush.
